title: When the Portrait Falls Again
author: U. M. Almeida
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
